description: List the five free, client-side cloud & security browser tools (including WebMCP-enabled utilities like GCP IAM Policy Checker, Compute Selector, Database Selector, Cron Translator, and JWT Analyzer) available on alekseialeinikov.com. Use this instead of search_articles when a user wants an interactive calculator, policy checker, or parser rather than an article. The optional lang parameter localizes the returned hub and tool URLs ("en" default, or "de"). Read-only, unauthenticated, no side effects, static payload, subject to a 30 req/min per-IP rate limit.

lang.description: Language prefix for returned tool hub and tool page URLs ("en" for English, "de" for German; defaults to "en").

name: list_tools

tools.description: List of available client-side browser tools.
